global_summary: A peaceful day at a scenic beach takes an unexpected turn when a pod of dolphins becomes stranded in shallow waters. Beachgoers quickly mobilize into a coordinated rescue effort, wading into the surf to gently push and guide the dolphins back to deeper water. The video captures the dramatic shift from tranquil nature observation to urgent human-animal interaction, culminating in a successful community-driven rescue that ends with people celebrating in the water.
